title: Wicked Witch Coleus - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Dramatic Dark Foliage
description:
Unleash a touch of magic with the stunning Wicked Witch Coleus!
KEY FEATURES
• Dramatic deep burgundy to chocolate foliage with chartreuse edges
• Ruffled leaf margins add unique texture
• Tolerant of sun or shade, highly adaptable
• Excellent heat tolerance and late-blooming for season-long colour
• Versatile for containers, borders, and mass plantings
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Coleus scutellarioides
Colour: Deep Burgundy to Chocolate with Chartreuse edges
Season: Spring, Summer (grown for foliage)
Growth Habit: Upright Thriller
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Sun or Shade
Soil: Humus-rich, moist, well-drained soil (pH 6.0-6.5)
Watering: Average; keep soil evenly moist, water when top 1-2 inches are dry
Spacing: 45-60 cm (18-24 inches)
Height: 60-100 cm (24-40 inches)
Spread: 45-90 cm (18-36 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zones 10-11 (often grown as an annual in UK)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant outdoors after all danger of frost has passed, when temperatures are consistently above 15°C.
• Pinch stem tips on young plants to encourage bushier growth and prune off flower spikes to maintain foliage presentation.
• Fertilise monthly with a balanced water-soluble feed during the growing season; use a slow-release fertiliser at planting.
• For overwintering indoors, bring plants in before frost, place in bright indirect light, and reduce watering.
• Ensure good drainage in pots to prevent root rot.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
